items.title: Introduction
items.text: Everything you need to sell: customers, orders, refunds, the product catalogue and webhooks. REST over HTTPS, JSON in and out, bearer-token authenticated. At a glance What you can do Making a request Reading this documentation

items.title: Use cases
items.text: Three things teams build with the Acme Commerce API, in the order people usually build them. Syncing customers from your CRM Taking an order and refunding it Reacting to events instead of polling

items.title: Versioning
items.text: This API serves 2 versions at once. The version is part of the path, so a request names the version it wants. Versions v2 compared with v1

items.title: Authentication
items.text: Authenticated endpoints expect a bearer token. Which endpoints need it A complete request

items.title: Errors
items.text: Errors are returned with a conventional HTTP status and a JSON body. Status codes used by this API Error body

items.title: Rate limiting
items.text: Requests are rate limited per client. Exceeding a limit returns 429 Too Many Requests. Limits Staying within the limit

items.title: Pagination
items.text: Every list endpoint pages the same way, so this is documented once here rather than repeated on each one. Requesting a page Reading the response Iterating safely

items.title: Issue an access token
items.text: Issue an access token Exchanges an API key pair for a short-lived bearer token. Tokens expire after one hour; request a new one rather than caching indefinitely. v2 key_id key_secret scopes

items.title: Revoke the current token
items.text: Revoke the current token Invalidates the token used to make this call. Idempotent — revoking an already-revoked token still returns 204. v2

items.title: List customers
items.text: List customers Returns a paginated list of customers, newest first. Use `status` to narrow the list, and `q` to search across name and email. v2 per_page page status q

items.title: Create a customer
items.text: Create a customer Creates a customer and, unless `send_invite` is false, emails them an invitation. v2 email name send_invite metadata

items.title: Retrieve a customer
items.text: Retrieve a customer v2 customer include

items.title: Update a customer
items.text: Update a customer Partial update — omitted fields are left untouched. v2 customer name status

items.title: Delete a customer
items.text: Delete a customer Permanently removes the customer and anonymises their orders. Prefer archiving via the update endpoint. v2 customer

items.title: List orders
items.text: List orders v2 per_page page status customer_id

items.title: Create an order
items.text: Create an order Creates an order in `pending` state. Send the `Idempotency-Key` header so a retried request cannot double-charge. v2 Idempotency-Key customer_id currency items

items.title: Retrieve an order
items.text: Retrieve an order v2 order

items.title: Refund an order
items.text: Refund an order Refunds all or part of a paid order. Partial refunds may be issued repeatedly up to the order total. v2 order amount reason

items.title: List products
items.text: List products Public catalogue. No credentials required, so this endpoint is safe to call from a browser. v2 per_page page currency q

items.title: Retrieve a product
items.text: Retrieve a product v2 product

items.title: List webhook endpoints
items.text: List webhook endpoints v2

items.title: Register a webhook endpoint
items.text: Register a webhook endpoint We POST a signed JSON payload to your URL for each subscribed event. Verify the `X-Acme-Signature` header before trusting a delivery. v2 url events
